person.name: Josh Boyer
person.positioning: Business architecture and automation | Insurance systems | Independent AI strategy
person.summary: Technology generalist with about twenty years of experience turning business requirements into repeatable rules, integrations and tools. Production work includes renewal automation, C#/.NET applications, Excel VBA claims-history loading and hands-on SQL; NEXUS is independent AI-assisted development.
